defs.def: coming from, found in or typical of the tropics 热带的；来自热带的；产于热带的

ex.s: Outbreaks tend to occur in tropical regions of subSaharan Africa, the largest to date being the 2013–2016 epidemic in West Africa, which infected 28,616 people and claimed 11,310 lives.
ex.t: 疫情往往发生在撒哈拉以南非洲的热带地区，迄今最大的一次是 2013–2016 年西非的疫情，感染了 28616 人，夺去了 11310 人的生命。

ex.s: Some recent studies have found that there were far fewer tropical cyclones than usual between 700 AD and 1000 AD.
ex.t: 近期一些研究发现，公元 700 年至 1000 年间的热带气旋比平时少得多。

ex.s: A wide variety of tropical wildlife also makes the reef its home.
ex.t: 种类繁多的热带野生动植物也把这片礁岩当成家园。

ex.s: EXAMPLE • According to the report submitted by researchers, between 20 and 25 percent of all annual carbon dioxide emissions are caused by the destruction of tropical forests.
ex.t: 示例　• 根据研究者提交的报告，每年全部二氧化碳排放量的 20% 至 25% 是由热带森林的破坏造成的。
